mapper.sql: m.menu_id, m.menu_name, m.parent_menu_id, parent.menu_name AS parent_menu_name, m.menu_type, m.page_id, p.title AS page_title, m.external_url, CASE WHEN m.menu_type = 'GROUP' THEN '메뉴 그룹' WHEN m.menu_type = 'URL' THEN m.external_url WHEN p.title IS NOT NULL THEN p.title ELSE '페이지 미지정' END AS target_label, m.display_pc, m.display_mobile, m.is_visible, m.open_new_window
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM cms_site_menu m LEFT JOIN cms_site_menu parent ON parent.menu_id = m.parent_menu_id LEFT JOIN cms_page p ON p.id = m.page_id ORDER BY m.display_order, m.menu_id

SELECT
FROM cms_site_menu m LEFT JOIN cms_site_menu parent ON parent.menu_id = m.parent_menu_id LEFT JOIN cms_page p ON p.id = m.page_id WHERE m.menu_id = #{menuId}
mapper.update: UPDATE cms_site_menu SET menu_name = #{menu.menuName}, menu_type = #{menu.menuType}, page_id = #{menu.pageId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, external_url = #{menu.externalUrl}, display_pc = #{menu.displayPc}, display_mobile = #{menu.displayMobile}, is_visible = #{menu.visible}, open_new_window = #{menu.openNewWindow}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
